/* cppi::274a57e1430b210fdfa5b795f19037532cf3932428aa99faa57e7ebe8c02d6bf */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 11 and 12
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 11:23:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "Custom_SQL_Query"."BD" AS "BD",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."abs_dR_AM" AS "abs_dR_AM",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."abs_dR_FX" AS "abs_dR_FX",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."abs_dR_LTR" AS "abs_dR_LTR",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."abs_dR_RM" AS "abs_dR_RM",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."assetmix_pv" AS "assetmix_pv",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."business_date" AS "business_date",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."dR_AM" AS "dR_AM",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."dR_FX" AS "dR_FX",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."dR_LTR" AS "dR_LTR",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."dR_RM" AS "dR_RM",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."dept" AS "dept",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."fx_pv" AS "fx_pv",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."ltr_pv" AS "ltr_pv",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."pos_id" AS "pos_id",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."program" AS "program",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."radar_pv" AS "radar_pv",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."rm_pv" AS "rm_pv",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."strategy" AS "strategy",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."stsecurityid" AS "stsecurityid"
FROM (
  SELECT 
    date(business_date) as BD, business_date,
    dept, strategy, program, stsecurityid, pos_id,
    radar_pv, rm_pv, fx_pv, ltr_pv, assetmix_pv,
    coalesce(radar_pv,0) - coalesce(rm_pv,0) as dR_RM, 
    coalesce(radar_pv,0) - coalesce(fx_pv,0) as dR_FX,
    coalesce(radar_pv,0) - coalesce(ltr_pv,0) as dR_LTR, 
    coalesce(radar_pv,0) - coalesce(assetmix_pv,0) as dR_AM,
    abs(coalesce(radar_pv,0) - coalesce(rm_pv,0)) as abs_dR_RM, 
    abs(coalesce(radar_pv,0) - coalesce(fx_pv,0)) as abs_dR_FX,

  where date(business_date) between date_trunc('day', current_date ) - interval '14' day
  and date_trunc('day', current_date ) + interval '1' day
) "Custom_SQL_Query"

SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

  on esmvp.business_date=l.business_date
  and l.parent_cppib_sec_id = cast(esmvp.cppib_sec_id as varchar)

  on und_esmv.business_date=l.business_date
  and und_esmv.abor_security_number = undrs.abor_security_number
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pc
  on l.business_date = pc.business_date
  and l.enterprise_party_id = pc.enterprise_party_id
left join asset.asset_security_identifiers ai1

  and cast(ai1.cppib_sec_id as varchar)=l.cppib_sec_id
left join asset.asset_security_identifiers ai2
  on ai2.business_date=l.business_date
  and ai2.scd_id = l.Parent_Security_Name
left join party.party_gics_classifications pgc
  on pgc.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(pgc.cppib_party_id as varchar) = l.cppib_party_id
  and pgc.level=1
left join party.party p

  and cast(p.cppib_party_id as varchar) = l.cppib_party_id
left join party.party pp
  on pp.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(pp.cppib_party_id as varchar) = esmvp.cppib_party_id
left join risk_prod.cppib_party_rating pr
  on date(pr.business_date)=l.business_date and pr.rating_agency= 'CPPIB'
  and l.cppib_party_id=cast(pr.cppib_party_id as varchar)
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pf
  on date(pf.business_date)=l.business_date
  and pf.model_portfolio = l.id_model_portfolio
  and pf.InvestmentStructure = (select max(distinct InvestmentStructure)
                                   from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten

                                   and InvestmentStructure like 'CPPIB_F%')
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc
  on rcc.business_date=l.business_date
  and l.country_of_exposure_code = rcc.country_code
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio rmp
  on date(rmp.business_date)=l.business_date
  and rmp.model_portfolio_id = l.id_model_portfolio
left join reference.scd_party_issuer brk
  on date(brk.business_date)=l.business_date
  and brk.party_id = l.broker_code
  and brk.broker = 'Yes'
left join reference.scd_party_issuer spi
  on date(spi.business_date)=l.business_date
  and spi.party_id = rs.abor_issuer_id

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'

                                from market.om_option_price aa

                            AND aa.best_bid > 0

                            AND aa.special_settlement_flag <> '1'
                            AND (

                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'C' THEN GREATEST(bb.close_price - aa.strike_price / 1000.0, 0)
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'P' THEN GREATEST(aa.strike_price / 1000.0 - bb.close_price, 0)
                                END
                            )
                        ORDER BY 
                            business_date, expiration_date, call_put_flag, strike ASC

/* cppi::098de3c671c056a06ab13d9c0f43c8d3f42ca63f40fbe7be8f95c40e814e1589 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 04 and 05
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 04:01:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::43c7fc2dcb32d9423ce4a0535a76fe9115e975762e2302dbb8100f94b95cf328 */
SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     day_of_week(query_date) AS day_of_week_value,
                     CASE
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date,
                     query_date AS original_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             final_dates AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as business_date,
                     date_format(business_date + interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AS as_of_date
                 FROM adjusted_date
             )
        select
            CASE
                WHEN hold.portfolio_group_id IN ('CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY', 'BCPP', 'ACPP')
                    THEN 'CPPIB GROUP'
                ELSE hold.portfolio_group_id
                END AS portfolio_group,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.portfolio_group_name IN ('CPPIB Group', 'CPPIB Supplementary', 'Base CPP', 'Additional CPP')
                    THEN 'CPPIB Group'
                ELSE hold.portfolio_group_id
                END AS portfolio_groupname,
            COALESCE(hold.portfolio_id, '') as portfolio,
            COALESCE(mp.model_portfolio_id, ' ') as mpcode,
            COALESCE(mp.model_portfolio_name, ' ') as mpname,
            COALESCE(mp.investment_department_sub_group_responsibility_code, ' ') as MPFC02,
            COALESCE(mp.sst_custody_account_code, ' ') as mpfc18,
            COALESCE(mp.sst_custody_account_name, '') as mpfc18_name,
            COALESCE(hold.security_group_id , '') as secgrp,
            COALESCE(hold.security_group_name , '') as secgrpname,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_type_id , '') as sectype,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_type_name, '') as sectypename,
            COALESCE(esc.esm_ticker, ' ') as ticker,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_instrument_type, '') as instypename,
            COALESCE(esc.cusip, ' ') as cusip,
            COALESCE(CAST(esc.isin as VARCHAR), ' ') as isin,
            COALESCE(esc.sedol, ' ') as sedol,
            COALESCE(CAST(hold.cppib_sec_id as VARCHAR), ' ') as cppib_security_id,
            COALESCE(esc.bloomberg_unique_id, ' ') as bb_uniqueid_code,
            COALESCE(iss.party_group, ' ') as issuer_group,
            COALESCE(iss.party_group, ' ') as issuer_groupname,
            COALESCE(esc.cppib_party_name, ' ') as issuer,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_code, ' ') as issuercty,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_name, ' ') as issuerctyname,
            COALESCE(port.portfolio_currency, '') as basecur,
            COALESCE(port_curr.currency_name, '') as basecurname,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_code, '') as localcur,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_name, '') as localcurname,
            COALESCE(sec.abor_exchange_id, ' ') as exchange_code,
            COALESCE(exc2.exchange_name, ' ') as exchange_name,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_code, ' ') as tradecty,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_name, ' ') as tradectyname,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.balance_nominal_number = CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.balance_nominal_number * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS balnomval,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price = CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT) AS VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanqc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.abor_maturity_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as matdate,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_maturity_date, '') as matdate_caroni,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.business_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as todate,
            COALESCE(hold.business_date, '') as todate_caroni,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_number, '') as security_no,
            ' ' as murex_port_code,
            COALESCE(und.sedol_id, '') as sedol_underly,
            COALESCE(und.isin_id, '') as isin_underly,
            COALESCE(und.bloomberg_unique_id, '') as bb_underly,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency = CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency
                    * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanpc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(esc.esm_issue_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as issue_date,
            COALESCE(esc.esm_issue_date, '') as issue_date_caroni,
            COALESCE(CAST(cast(repo.repo_nominal as BIGINT) as VARCHAR), '0') as repo_nominal,
            COALESCE(und.abor_security_number, '') as secno_underly
        from holdings.scd_holdings_main hold
                 join final_dates fd on hold.business_date = fd.business_date
                 left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esc on hold.business_date = date_format(esc.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
            and hold.cppib_sec_id = cast(esc.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                 left join holdings.repo_holdings_details repo on hold.business_date = date_format(repo.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') and hold.scd_holding_key_id = repo.id_source_holding
                 left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on hold.business_date = mp.business_date and hold.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
                 left join reference.scd_portfolio port on hold.portfolio_id = port.portfolio_id and hold.business_date = port.business_date
                 left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on hold.business_date = date_format(asi.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
            and hold.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                 left join party.party party on cast(party.cppib_party_id as varchar) = esc.cppib_party_id and date_format(party.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
                 left join (select id_cppib_party, max(party_group) as party_group
                            from reference.scd_party_issuer iss
                                     join final_dates fd on iss.business_date = fd.business_date
                            group by id_cppib_party) iss
                           on iss.id_cppib_party = cast(party.cppib_party_id as varchar)
                 left join reference.reference_country_codes iss_country on iss_country.country_code = party.domicile_country_code
            and iss_country.business_date = party.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_country_codes trade_country on trade_country.country_code = esc.esm_country_code
            and date_format(trade_country.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_currency_codes port_curr on date_format(port_curr.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
            and port_curr.currency_code = port.portfolio_currency
                 left join reference.reference_currency_codes local_curr on date_format(local_curr.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
            and local_curr.currency_code = hold.quotation_currency_code
                 left join reference.scd_securities sec on sec.abor_security_number = hold.abor_security_number and sec.business_date = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.scd_securities und on sec.abor_underlying_instrument_id = und.scd_security_key_id and sec.business_date = und.business_date
                 left join
             (select exchange_id, max(exchange_name) as exchange_name
              from (select mic as exchange_id, max(mic_name) as exchange_name from reference.reference_exchange_codes exc where
                  date_format(exc.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = '2025-05-06' group by mic
                    union
                    select exchange_code as exchange_id, max(vendor_exchange_name) as exchange_name
                    from reference.reference_exchange_codes_map
                    group by exchange_code
                    union
                    select 'INT' as exchange_code, 'Internal' as exchange_name)
              group by exchange_id
             ) as exc2
             on exc2.exchange_id = sec.abor_exchange_id
        where (hold.balance_nominal_number != 0 or
                hold.balance_nominal_number_unsettled != 0 or
                hold.clean_value_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.next_dividend_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency != 0)) T LIMIT 0

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (

        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     day_of_week(query_date) AS day_of_week_value,

                     date_format(business_date + interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AS as_of_date
                 FROM adjusted_date
             )
        select
            CASE
                WHEN hold.portfolio_group_id IN ('CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY', 'BCPP', 'ACPP')
                    THEN 'CPPIB GROUP'
                ELSE hold.portfolio_group_id
                END AS portfolio_group,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.portfolio_group_name IN ('CPPIB Group', 'CPPIB Supplementary', 'Base CPP', 'Additional CPP')
                    THEN 'CPPIB Group'
                ELSE hold.portfolio_group_id
                END AS portfolio_groupname,
            COALESCE(hold.portfolio_id, '') as portfolio,
            COALESCE(mp.model_portfolio_id, ' ') as mpcode,

            COALESCE(mp.investment_department_sub_group_responsibility_code, ' ') as MPFC02,
            COALESCE(mp.sst_custody_account_code, ' ') as mpfc18,

            COALESCE(hold.security_group_name , '') as secgrpname,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_type_id , '') as sectype,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_type_name, '') as sectypename,
            COALESCE(esc.esm_ticker, ' ') as ticker,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_instrument_type, '') as instypename,
            COALESCE(esc.cusip, ' ') as cusip,
            COALESCE(CAST(esc.isin as VARCHAR), ' ') as isin,
            COALESCE(esc.sedol, ' ') as sedol,
            COALESCE(CAST(hold.cppib_sec_id as VARCHAR), ' ') as cppib_security_id,
            COALESCE(esc.bloomberg_unique_id, ' ') as bb_uniqueid_code,
            COALESCE(iss.party_group, ' ') as issuer_group,
            COALESCE(iss.party_group, ' ') as issuer_groupname,
            COALESCE(esc.cppib_party_name, ' ') as issuer,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_code, ' ') as issuercty,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_name, ' ') as issuerctyname,
            COALESCE(port.portfolio_currency, '') as basecur,
            COALESCE(port_curr.currency_name, '') as basecurname,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_code, '') as localcur,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_name, '') as localcurname,
            COALESCE(sec.abor_exchange_id, ' ') as exchange_code,

            COALESCE(trade_country.country_code, ' ') as tradecty,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_name, ' ') as tradectyname,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.balance_nominal_number = CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.balance_nominal_number * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS balnomval,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price = CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT) AS VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanqc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.abor_maturity_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as matdate,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_maturity_date, '') as matdate_caroni,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.business_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as todate,
            COALESCE(hold.business_date, '') as todate_caroni,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_number, '') as security_no,
            ' ' as murex_port_code,
            COALESCE(und.sedol_id, '') as sedol_underly,
            COALESCE(und.isin_id, '') as isin_underly,
            COALESCE(und.bloomberg_unique_id, '') as bb_underly,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency = CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency
                    * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanpc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(esc.esm_issue_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as issue_date,
            COALESCE(esc.esm_issue_date, '') as issue_date_caroni,
            COALESCE(CAST(cast(repo.repo_nominal as BIGINT) as VARCHAR), '0') as repo_nominal,
            COALESCE(und.abor_security_number, '') as secno_underly
        from holdings.scd_holdings_main hold
                 join final_dates fd on hold.business_date = fd.business_date
                 left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esc on hold.business_date = date_format(esc.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
            and hold.cppib_sec_id = cast(esc.cppib_sec_id as varchar)

            and local_curr.currency_code = hold.quotation_currency_code
                 left join reference.scd_securities sec on sec.abor_security_number = hold.abor_security_number and sec.business_date = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.scd_securities und on sec.abor_underlying_instrument_id = und.scd_security_key_id and sec.business_date = und.business_date

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-01')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-01')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",

    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-01')

		, case

				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from

					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

			  business_date

				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix

			, lt_agg.year_month

			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency

			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (

				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc

				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency

				, pnl_4yp_rc

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

		from

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 06 and 07
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 06:58:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::c2da053d324e9d0ffe8259300e86df3e4f0ada7a2c53550416343170fb282744 */
SELECT
  base.scd_holding_key_id,
  base.abor_security_type_name,
  base.abor_security_name,
  base.dirty_value_total_pc,
  COALESCE(lt.total_lookthrough_value_pc, 0) AS total_lookthrough_value_pc,
  ABS(base.dirty_value_total_pc - COALESCE(lt.total_lookthrough_value_pc, 0)) AS difference_pc
FROM (
  SELECT
    mh.scd_holding_key_id,
    mh.abor_security_type_name,
    mh.abor_security_name,
    mh.abor_holdings_leg_no,
    SUM(mh.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency) AS dirty_value_total_pc
  FROM
    holdings.scd_holdings_main mh
  WHERE
    mh.portfolio_group_id IN ('ACPP', 'BCPP', 'CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY')
    AND mh.business_date = '2025-05-31'
  GROUP BY
    mh.scd_holding_key_id,
    mh.abor_security_type_name,
    mh.abor_security_name,
    mh.abor_holdings_leg_no
) base
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    lt.parent_holding_key,
    lt.leg_no,
    SUM(lt.total_market_value_pc) AS total_lookthrough_value_pc
  FROM
    holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough lt
  WHERE
    lt.business_date = DATE('2025-05-31')
  GROUP BY
    lt.parent_holding_key,
    lt.leg_no
) lt
  ON base.scd_holding_key_id = lt.parent_holding_key
  and base.abor_holdings_leg_no = lt.leg_no
  and not base.abor_security_type_name in ('IRS Interest Rate')
ORDER BY
  ABS(base.dirty_value_total_pc - COALESCE(lt.total_lookthrough_value_pc, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 100

/* cppi::2e1e2fecf94592bcfb0cda40e4079865af614e95ed7e90f6d71834a10237799e */
WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_prod
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='ACPP'
    and sd.business_date = dh.business_date
where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-05-30'
    )
select ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure)                                      as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) as conc_sector_limit,
       case
           when max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit) > 0 then round(sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                     (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) *
                                                                     100, 2)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.acpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.acpp_sector_conc_board_limit))
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
         join radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.gics_sector='Financials' and f.business_date = ule.business_date

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.acpp_credit_exposure is not null
  and f.business_date = '2025-05-30'
group by ule.gics_sector, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(acpp_credit_exposure) desc

SELECT
            from_currency as from_currency,
            to_currency as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end,6) as mid_price,
            business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE
            from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD'
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            and business_date = Date('2025-06-02')
        UNION
        Select
            MainTable.to_currency as from_currency,
            'CAD' as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then
                MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                end,6) as calc_mid_price,
            MainTable.business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
        Left Join
        (
            SELECT
                case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end as mid_price,
                business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = Date('2025-06-02')
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
        ) as CAD_Rate on
            MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
        WHERE
            MainTable.business_date = Date('2025-06-02')
            and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD'
            and MainTable.mid_price != 0
            and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date,from_currency

		COUNT(*) >= 500

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

SELECT "model_portfolio" AS "3eb096de-723f-442a-af57-4347e6585f8f.model_portfolio", "analytic_type" AS "3eb096de-723f-442a-af57-4347e6585f8f.analytic_type", COUNT(*) AS "count", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "model_portfolio" NULLS FIRST) AS "$RANK_1", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "analytic_type" DESC) AS "$RANK_2"
FROM (SELECT *
FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics
WHERE portfolio_type = 'IP'
	AND department = 'Total Fund Management' 
	AND ((analytic_type in  ('VAR_10YR','VAR_5YR') AND confidence_level = 0.95)
	    OR (analytic_type in ('PV','VOLATILITY_10YR','VOLATILITY_5YR'))
		OR analytic_type in ('CS01', 'DV01','SOURCE_SYSTEM_NOTIONAL'))
		ORDER BY business_date ASC) AS "TFM_Analytics"
WHERE date_trunc('day', CAST(CAST(PARSE_DATETIME("business_date", 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) = date_trunc('day', CAST(CAST(PARSE_DATETIME('2025-05-30 00:00:00', 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) AND "model_portfolio" IN ('TFMFXCO', 'TFMFXCM', 'IPCCMFISAH') AND "analytic_type" IN ('DV01', 'PV', 'VAR_10YR', 'VOLATILITY_5YR')
GROUP BY "model_portfolio", "analytic_type"
) AS "t"
WHERE "$RANK_1" <= 500 AND "$RANK_2" > 100 AND "$RANK_2" <= 200
ORDER BY "$RANK_1", "$RANK_2"
) AS "t0"

	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,

		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 14:08:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

 and h.balance_nominal_number != 0

 h.abor_security_id,
 t.party_name,

	client_ip

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y Rolling'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level"

			from

			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (

					and periods_per_year = 365

			union all

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly

		) perf

			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where

			and (

				(

				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

), perf as (

			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' )
			and "level" = 1

	cross join unnest (

			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

	rcc_incorp_country.country_name esm_incorp_country_name,

	st.price price_qc,
	st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency price_pc,
	st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
	es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
	es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	smp.investment_strategy_name,
	smp.investment_department_name,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.investment_type_name,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
	st.portfolio_id,
	st.ibor_reason,
	ss.abor_coupon_rate,
	st.dividend_per_share,
	st.borrowing_account,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency
from (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_transaction_number_primary_key order by business_date desc) as rn
	from trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
	where transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) st
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio )
	and st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id

	from party.enterprise_party

	and ep.rn = 1*/
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	and ss.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities )
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and rec.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country
	on es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
	and rcc_exchange_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
	and rcc_incorp_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
	)sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
	select abor_transaction_number,
    		business_date,
    		transaction_cancellation_flag,
    		trade_date,
    		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
 	from trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
 	group by abor_transaction_number,
    	business_date,
    	transaction_cancellation_flag,
    	trade_date
	) stc
	on st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
	and st.business_date = stc.business_date
	and st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
	and st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
left join reference.reference_currency_codes rcc
	on st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
	and rcc.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_currency_codes )
where st.rn = 1 ) ds LIMIT 0

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 15 and 16
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 15:41:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

  WHERE (("rmv_position"."investment_dept" = 'Active Equities') AND (CAST(CAST("rmv_position"."business_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) = CAST('2025-01-15' AS DATE)) AND ("rmv_position"."investment_strat" = 'LatAm') AND ("rmv_position"."portfolio_type" = 'IP') AND ("rmv_position"."product_type" IN ('Common Stock', 'Common Stock Private', 'Convertible Bond', 'Equity Swap', 'Private Emerging Mkt Fund', 'Synthetic Equity Index', 'Unit')))

    "rmv_position"."sub_program"

  INNER JOIN (

      "rmv_position"."program" AS "program",

/* cppi::3bf73142ccc21b8d7d06370b639578773bb49ea10c2e758e6a7bcbdb1aa70bb3 */
SELECT
            from_currency as from_currency,
            to_currency as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end,6) as mid_price,
            business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE
            from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD'
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            and business_date = Date('2025-06-02')
        UNION
        Select
            MainTable.to_currency as from_currency,
            'CAD' as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then
                MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                end,6) as calc_mid_price,
            MainTable.business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
        Left Join
        (
            SELECT
                case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end as mid_price,
                business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = Date('2025-06-02')
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
        ) as CAD_Rate on
            MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
        WHERE
            MainTable.business_date = Date('2025-06-02')
            and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD'
            and MainTable.mid_price != 0
            and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date,from_currency

select count(*)
from (
    select *,
    row_number() over (partition by scd_transaction_number_primary_key order by business_date desc) as rn
    from trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
    where transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) st
left join (
    select *,
    row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
    from asset.enterprise_security
) es
    on st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
    and es.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
    on smp.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio )
    and st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join (
    select *,
    row_number() over (partition by scd_party_id order by business_date desc) as rn
    from party.enterprise_party
) ep
    on st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id
    and ep.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_securities ss
    on st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
    and ss.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities )
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
    on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
    and rec.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country
    on es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
    and rcc_exchange_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
    on es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
    and rcc_incorp_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
    select *, 
    row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
    from reference.scd_portfolio
    )sp
    on sp.latest = 1
    and sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
